run_benchmark_comparison: run compare.py benchmarks mode to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables
run_filtered_comparison: run compare.py filters mode to compare two filters within a single benchmark file
run_cross_benchmark_filtered_comparison: run compare.py benchmarksfiltered mode to compare filters across two different benchmark files
run_comparison_with_utest: run compare.py with alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U statistical test
run_aggregates_only_comparison: run compare.py with display aggregates only flag to show only aggregate results from repeated runs
